> Enghouse Homestay Hanoi View all photos Enghouse Homestay Enghouse Homestay Hanoi hostel lies in Cau Giay with a laid-back dining scene, encompassing Vietnamese eateries serving seafood and noodle dishes, and several Korean restaurants, and the nearest bus stop, So 5 Lo 4C - Vu Pham Ham, is merely 0.8 km away. Ngoc Khanh Lake is within 25 minutes' walk of the Hanoi hostel, and the nearby cultural attractions include the modern Vietnamese Women's Museum, which is approximately a 15-minute drive away. Also, the hostel is 4.1 km from such natural sights as the shaded park "Hanoi Botanical Garden". The bustling Hanoi Night Market is around a 20-minute drive from the accommodation. Enghouse hostel is situated 4.3 km from Ha Noi train station.
